# kion_gcp_service_account (Resource)

Manages a Kion Gcp Service Account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_gcp_service_account" "example" {
  # Required
  email                     = "example"
  enable_federation_support = false
  gcp_project_id            = "example"
  name                      = "example"
  unique_id                 = "example"

  # Optional
  # description         = "example"
  # disabled            = false
  # display_name        = "example"
  # oauth_client_id     = "example"
  # oauth_client_secret = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email is the google-designated email id for the service account
- `enable_federation_support` (Boolean) EnableFederationSupport represents if the service account will be used for federation
- `gcp_project_id` (String) GCPProjectID is the Google Cloud Project that the service account was created in
- `name` (String) Name is the kebab-case name for the service account
- `unique_id` (String) UniqueID is the client id used to authenticate in tandem with a key

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description is a brief description of the service account
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disabled is true if the service account is disabled with GCP
- `display_name` (String) DisplayName is a human-friendly name for the service account
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuthClientID is the client id for an oauth client in the service account's project
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuthClientSecret is the client secret for an oauth client in the service account's project

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GCP service account id.
